# Three questions

`customer_support.df.de_escalation.three_questions` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **decision_framework**

> The three questions a heated customer is actually asking: do you understand what happened to me, is anyone in charge of it, and when will I know more.

Answering the technical question they typed while leaving these three unanswered is the most common shape of a reply that is correct and useless. Any draft can be checked against them in seconds, which is what makes this the most practical framework here.
